title: App generator
description: Generates a runnable backend project from the registered resource models

app.description: Registered app-schema declaring the composition (pages, nav, dashboard); mutually exclusive with models/dashboard

appFile.description: Path to an app-schema JSON file (e.g. downloaded from the studio wizard); mutually exclusive with app/models/dashboard

models.description: Comma-separated model names (defaults to all registered models)
models.x-prompt: ¿Qué modelos incluye? (separados por comas; vacío = todos)

skipInstall.description: Skip npm install and the Spartan UI materialisation

ui.description: Component library used by the emitted frontend

database.description: Persistence engine of the emitted app (postgres/TypeORM or mongo/Mongoose)

auth.description: Authentication of the emitted app (exclusive slot)

dashboard.description: Emit a KPI dashboard (one total per resource) as the home screen
dashboard.x-prompt: ¿Añado un dashboard de KPIs como pantalla de inicio?

plugins.description: Comma-separated additive plugins (email, observability); migrations is built in and authentication is a slot
plugins.x-prompt: ¿Qué plugins añado? (email, observability — separados por comas; 'none' para ninguno)
